name: browser
description: DEPRECATED — the browser plugin now ships from its own repository, https://github.com/5dive-ai/5dive-browser (`sudo 5dive plugin add 5dive-ai/5dive-browser`). This copy still resolves and still installs, because boxes provisioned before the move name it today — but it is frozen and receives no fixes. Do NOT migrate yet if you are on 1.9.x: the new repository is at 1.8.0 today and does not yet carry the per-box brokered login this copy has, so the move would be a downgrade. Migrate once it is at or above this version; see CHANGES.md. Persistent human-authenticated browser sessions — log into a site once by hand, then let deterministic adapters operate it. Never solves a security challenge; it stops and asks you.

verbs.name: browser
verbs.summary: log into a site once, then let adapters operate it

setup.hint: browser needs a root-created profile store that 5dive will not create behind your back, and a Chrome on the box.
